answer_1.quote: The aim of Question Generation (QG) is the production of meaningful questions given a set of input passages and corresponding answers...

answer_4.quote: We manually examine 50 randomly selected questions, 31 (62%) of which were deemed high quality questions. The remaining 19 contain various errors with some questions containing more than one error, including mismatched wh-word and answer (12%), missing information needed to locate the answer (8%), factual errors (10%) and grammatical errors (8) (16%)
